comments.body: This looks great, have you tried to do buildings at all?

replies.author: Feisty-Scheme-8356
replies.body:
Thank you! Not extensively yet. Most of my testing has focused on hard-surface objects and game assets. Buildings are definitely on my list though, and I think the pipeline should work well for many architectural structures. I’d love to see your results if you give it a try!  
Also I see an example using img2threejs from others in X, you can try:   
[https://x.com/hamster\_wat/status/2078996887361794149?s=20](https://x.com/hamster_wat/status/2078996887361794149?s=20)
